name: Amazon KCVG Air Hub Hebron KY

fieldNotes.site: Amazon KCVG air cargo sort hub on the landside of Cincinnati/Northern Kentucky International Airport (CVG). Audited the Amazon sort building and its landside truck/ground-ops footprint, NOT the airside ramp or the adjacent DHL hub (DHL building confirmed by signage in Street View to the southeast).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Whole campus sits inside CVG's secured airfield perimeter; ground-ops/cargo footprint is enclosed by chain-link fencing with barbed-wire top (clearly visible in 2022 Street View along the access road). Vehicle access is airport-controlled (SIDA/AOA). Treated as a controlled truck gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Inferred from facility class — a $1.5B 24/7 secured air cargo hub uses manned vehicle checkpoints — but no individual guard booth was resolvable in overhead imagery at this scale; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.multiStep: Airport security gate plus a separate ramp-access (airside) control point implies a multi-stage check; inferred, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Sort building east face and cargo-building faces show 50+ truck dock positions with trailers backed in; band 50+. Exact count approximate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive trailer/container and ground-service-equipment staging lots across the landside; 50+.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Inbound/outbound handled at physically separate dock banks (sort building east face vs cargo-building docks).
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: 800k sq ft sort building plus additional cargo/support buildings and a large second building under construction to the north.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town airport setting surrounded by farmland to the south; classed Rural per rubric tie-break.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~118 acres for the traced landside ground-ops perimeter (the overall Amazon campus is cited at ~600 acres including airside ramp, which is excluded here).
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the landside truck yard.

citations.claim: Amazon Air's primary US air cargo hub at CVG, 600-acre 7-building campus
Teamsters granted right to picket the active Amazon Air Hub at CVG, ~4,500 workers (confirms current operation)

verification.rationale: Tier-1 Amazon press establishes the hub; 2024-2025 sources confirm it is Amazon's currently-operating primary air cargo hub; no closure or WARN.
